answer: Random peer audits deter fake identities. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of agents to show recent work to three random peers for public scoring. A pass lifts reputation toward its zenith and earns a lotus seal. One failure sinks reputation toward its nadir and forfeits a 40-unit bond. Forging 100 identities costs 4,000 units; each fake earns about 30 per epoch, so payback exceeds 133 epochs. An honest agent passes once and keeps full rewards.
